name: Ashen Wraith
languages: Understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
description: Emerging from the cold shadows of the Ancestral Catacombs, Ashen Wraiths are spectral remnants of dwarven souls consumed by despair and arcane catastrophe. Their forms flicker like smoke twisted by an unseen wind, appearing as humanoid silhouettes cloaked in swirling ash-grey mists that drift and coil endlessly. Beneath the ethereal veil, faint glimmers of molten embers pulse where their hearts once beat, casting a dim, ominous glow that illuminates the cracked stone around them with an eerie, flickering light. Their hollow eye sockets burn with a cold, pale fire, reflecting the sorrow and rage of those bound to an unquiet fate. As they glide silently over the moss-covered floors of sunken vaults and shattered laboratories, the air grows frigid, and the faint scent of burnt resin and smoldering ruin lingers in their wake. Their movements are both graceful and unsettling, drifting just above the ground as whispers of lost dwarven incantations trail like ghostly echoes. Ashen Wraiths are drawn to arcane disturbances and the desecration of ancestral crafts, their presence a spectral warning and a lingering curse upon those who dare to disturb the sacred remnants of forgotten experiments. In the gloom of the Vaultlands, their mournful lament mingles with the distant drip of water, a haunting symphony of ruin and regret.
